noelle (Docs): Hey all — opened a docs PR to add an RHEL9-focused airgapped preflight + HSM tunneling pattern. It covers hybrid iptables->nft setups, GPG-signed offline bundle verification, and a tiny Python upload example that goes via an HTTP proxy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4187. Would appreciate infra + sec + support eyes.

hannes (Eng-Infra): Nice. Can you add a note for systems using firewalld (how to add passthrough for ESP/UDP4500 and our 8443 bundle endpoint)? Also include an iptables-to-nft translation hint for older images that still use legacy rules.

noelle (Docs): Will do. Draft snippets below (non-prod). I kept GPG steps minimal so we don't paste keys: 

```
# verify gpg signature + checksum
gpg --verify offline-bundle.tar.gz.sig offline-bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum --check offline-bundle.sha256

# quick Python upload via HTTP proxy
import requests
with open('offline-bundle.tar.gz','rb') as f:
    r = requests.post('https://10.0.10.5:8443/api/bundles',
                      headers={'Authorization':'Bearer <REDACTED>'},
                      data=f,
                      proxies={'https':'http://127.0.0.1:3128'})
    print(r.status_code)
```

mica (Eng-Platform): Good. For the HSM tunnel section can you show both a systemd-managed stunnel unit and a socat one-liner fallback? Also add a short MTU test note: `ping -s 1400 <hsm-ip>` and suggest checking DF bit handling on gateways.

noelle (Docs): Adding stunnel systemd service excerpt and socat fallback: 
```
# stunnel minimal (client)
client=yes
[redwood-hsm]
accept=127.0.0.1:15000
connect=hsm.net:15000
CAfile=/etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem
verify=2

# socat quick tunnel (fallback)
socat TCP-LISTEN:15000,fork,reuseaddr OPENSSL:hsm.net:15000,verify=1,cert=/etc/ssl/certs/client.pem
```

sora (Security): Quick security items: do not paste private keys, do not include long-lived tokens in examples (use ephemeral bundle-upload tokens), and include a short blurb recommending PKCS#11 ACLs that limit operations to signing/unwrap for the installer only. I'll add exact role names in the PR comment.

hannes (Eng-Infra): For firewalld: example to open the bundle endpoint and ESP: 
```
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8443/tcp
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-protocol=esp
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=4500/udp
firewall-cmd --reload
```
Also, for hosts that still use iptables-legacy add a note: `iptables-restore < /etc/iptables/legacy-redwood.rules` and link to nft translation tool.

ben (Support): From tickets: cloud-init / first-boot services sometimes race and the stunnel service fails because network-manager rewrites resolv.conf. Can you add a systemd `ExecStartPre` probe that waits for DNS + proxy port 3128 before uploading? Example: `ExecStartPre=/bin/bash -c "for i in {1..30}; do nc -z 127.0.0.1 3128 && dig @127.0.0.1 redwood.internal && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1"`. I can sanity-check wording after commit.

noelle (Docs): Adding the ExecStartPre probe and a small troubleshooting table: symptom -> first-check -> next step. Draft: 
- Installer failing to upload: check proxy reachable (nc), check sha256, check TLS cert CN.
- HSM TLS handshake errors: check MTU (ping -s), run `openssl s_client -connect <hsm-ip>:15000 -servername hsm.internal` to inspect chain.
